 BREAKING: Storm leaves damage path in Mesa; 6 tornado warnings issued in northern Arizona 6 weather alerts in effect Strong storms, rain chances high across Arizona; tornado risk possible 
 Chance of rain and showers in the Valley later this afternoon. April Warnecke has your forecast. By April Warnecke Published : Oct. 21, 2026 at 5:59 AM MST | Updated : 18 minutes ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google PHOENIX (AZFamily) — Today and tomorrow are First Alert Weather Days for strong storms and heavy rain potential across Arizona. 
 Severe weather has already resulted in multiple tornado warnings for parts of the High County early Wednesday morning. 
 The National Weather Service issued additional tornado warnings later in the morning for portions of Yavapai and Coconino counties. Flagstaff and surrounding areas were included in a warning issued shortly after 9 a.m.
 The warnings were issued due to radar-indicated rotation, not ground observation. 
 There is a slight risk of severe storms with tornadoes throughout today and tomorrow, especially in the High Country. The Valley also has a slight risk. 
 Download the First Alert Weather App    First Alert Weather Radar    Rainfall Totals Another concern is the potential for heavy rain. A Flood Watch is in effect today and tomorrow. 
 Valley rain and storm chances are near 40 percent this morning, climbing to 60 percent by this afternoon, evening and overnight. Hail and wind damage are also possible. Thursday’s storm chances remain high, including the threat of severe weather. 
 Friday and the weekend look to be dry.
